summary: Deliver the backward-compatible intent-architecture reading boundary: unchanged no-argument consumers receive the complete canonical graph, query purpose is explicit, audit without subject is rejected, and graph-tidy always bypasses semantic retrieval for a complete canonical snapshot.
notes: Viewpoint binding: Application Usage Viewpoint. Concern: downstream consumers retain complete no-argument reading while purpose and audit subject boundaries are explicit. Purpose: designing, deciding, and handoff preparation.

View ownership: grag-compatibility-usage models consumer and process use of the query service and canonical source; grag-request-purpose-usage models request interpretation and validation realization; grag-tidy-canonical-usage models graph-tidy use of the complete canonical graph.

Human approval evidence: the 2026-07-24 chat explicitly approved DT-01, DT-02, DT-03, and DT-12 same-element testcase variants and approved chat evidence as the orchestrator gate; schema-unsupported approvedByHuman fields are intentionally absent.
Trace proposal design/KG/ImplementationToIntentTraceProposal.json was validated, accepted, and applied without changing approved behavior or View content.

Global validator correction: the remaining 16 mounted testcase acceptanceCriteria values were mapped to the 14 executable paths recorded in design/KG/ImplementationToIntentTraceProposal.json; names, semantics, Inputs, control points, observation points, functional-point mappings, relationships, and Views were unchanged.

Runner evidence preservation: the latest full architecture baseline reported 24 total, 5 passed, and 19 failed-or-invalid; all 21 runner-owned deliveryStatus attributes already present in SystemArchitecture.json were retained without manual change.

Evidence-backed exclusions: viewpoint Grouping elements are navigation anchors; existing semantic retrieval, closure, index, alignment, outcome, and quality elements are unchanged context and are outside this compatibility-contract implementation slice because no-argument and graph-tidy paths bypass semantic retrieval.
No deliveryStatus attribute was manually edited or used as fabricated pass evidence.
